A '''deck gunner''' worked onboard [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]] during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with light skin and black hair.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==History==
[[File:Unidentified_deck_gunner_-_Manga_ROTJ_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Leia attacks the gunner]]
After the initial attempt by [[Han Solo/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his friends to free [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], the gunner was present when Skywalker, Solo, and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] intended execution turned into an all-out battle. He saw Skywalker kill [[Vizam/Legends|Vizam]] after the Nikto had fired a [[Gi/9 antipersonnel laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] on the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|skiff]] carrying Solo, Chewbacca and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> He rushed to take control of the cannon while Skywalker fought several guards.<ref name="Marvel ROTJ 2" />

The deck gunner found the Rebels' skiff too tempting a target to pass up,<ref name="Marvel ROTJ 2" /> but failed to notice the arrival of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia Organa]], who knocked him out with a [[Vibro-lance/Legends|vibro-lance]].<ref name="Manga ROTJ 2">[[Star Wars Manga: Return of the Jedi 2|''Star Wars Manga: Return of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref> Leia then used a [[Me/7 double laser cannon/Legends|larger cannon]] to blast the deck of the barge, moments before the Rebels' escaped and the sail barge exploded.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified_deck_gunner_-_Actor.jpg|200px|thumb|The actor playing the deck gunner on the set of ''Return of the Jedi'']]
{{Quote|Aboard the larger vessel, this vulnerable chain of Wookiee and Humans is too tempting a target for the deck gunner to pass up... so tempting he does not notice a new element in the battle... until too late!|Narrator, ''Return of the Jedi'' 2|<ref name="Marvel ROTJ 2" />}}
This gunner can briefly be seen in {{Film|VI}}, but Leia's attack on him was cut from the film. A fraction of that footage can be seen in the final film where Leia moves towards the gunner and picks up the staff before Luke tells her to point the cannon at the deck.<ref name="ROTJ" /> A far off view of that full scene being filmed can be found in some behind the scenes footage.<ref name="Leia vs Guard">{{YouTube|video=3JMZBezCRKk|text=STAR WARS - CARRIE FISHER AS SLAVE LEIA - RARE FOOTAGE|channel=channel/UCM5Y6btf0GWjD-oiDN21UTg|name=STEPVA}}</ref>

Promotional photos of the attack were released<ref name="Topps ROTJ 52">{{Topps|set=1983 Topps Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Series 1|cardname=Princess Leia Swings Into Action!|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/72969/cid/5256902/1983-Topps-Return-Of-The-Jedi-52-Princess-Leia-Swings-Into-Action!}}</ref> and one was adapted for one panel of the [[Marvel Comics]] [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (1983)|adaptation]] of the film.<ref name="Marvel ROTJ 2" /> A [[1984]] [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Coloring Book (1984)|coloring book]] includes an image of the scene shown from the opposite angle the photos use.<ref name="Coloring">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Coloring Book (1984)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Coloring Book'' (1984)]]</ref> The scene was also adapted in the second issue of the ''[[Star Wars Manga: Return of the Jedi]]'' comic series, where the character is shown falling over the side of the barge after being knocked out.<ref name="Manga ROTJ 2" />
